red_flags: Single-instructor school (William); all reviews praise the same person, so feedback reflects one person's style
All visible reviews are 5/5 with no mixed or critical reviews surfaced, limiting balance
No independent verified-customer platform (klantenvertellen) page found; reviews are unverified Google reviews
Review count inconsistent across aggregators (9 on clickdrive vs 22 cited elsewhere)
review_summary: Students consistently describe instructor William as calm, clear and good-humoured, crediting his tailored, no-unnecessary-lessons approach and ability to ease exam nerves for passing (often first time). Only glowing 5-star Google reviews were found and no verified-customer (klantenvertellen) reviews, so the picture is uniformly positive but single-platform and unverified.
